name: Build & Ship Your First VR/MR App — AI-Powered Development with Unity & Meta Quest

xr_setup.hook: Before a single line of VR code, your headset must talk to Unity. What stack connects them?
xr_setup.recall: What do you need to build VR for Quest in Unity?
xr_setup.answer: Unity 6 + the Meta XR SDK, with the Android/Quest build target + an XR rig

ai_vr_workflow.hook: You don't hand-type every C# line anymore. What's the modern VR build loop?
ai_vr_workflow.answer: describe it in English -> the agent writes the C# -> test in VR -> iterate

vr_prompt.hook: Two prompts to a coding agent: one gets working VR, one gets junk. What's the difference?
vr_prompt.recall: What makes a good VR feature prompt?
vr_prompt.answer: the goal + Unity/XR context + constraints + how to verify it in the headset

hand_interaction.hook: In VR your hands ARE the controller. How do you let a user grab a virtual object?
hand_interaction.recall: How do you make an object grabbable in VR?

haptics.hook: A grab with no feedback feels fake. What makes virtual touch feel real?
haptics.answer: a controller vibration on interaction — it makes virtual touch feel physical

world_space_ui.hook: A flat screen-menu pasted over VR makes people sick. What UI actually works?
world_space_ui.recall: What UI works in VR, and why?
world_space_ui.answer: world-space UI (panels placed in 3D) with poke/laser interaction — not a screen overlay

vr_environment.hook: A grey room isn't an experience. What turns a demo into a place?
vr_environment.recall: What makes VR feel like a real place?
vr_environment.answer: a skybox, Quest-friendly lighting, particles, and spatial audio

spatial_audio.hook: A sound that comes from everywhere breaks immersion. What fixes it?
spatial_audio.recall: What is spatial audio in VR?
spatial_audio.answer: sound positioned in 3D so it comes from the right direction + distance

vr_locomotion.hook: Move a user the wrong way in VR and they feel sick. Name the comfort-safe options.
vr_locomotion.answer: teleport, smooth move, snap turn, comfort vignette — and let the user choose

vr_persistence.hook: A user returns tomorrow — how does the app remember them?
vr_persistence.recall: How do you persist progress across VR sessions?
vr_persistence.answer: PlayerPrefs / JSON saved locally + a Menu->Session->Summary state machine

vr_multiplayer.hook: Two headsets, one shared room. What makes that possible?
vr_multiplayer.answer: networking (Photon Fusion), networked head+hand avatars, and spatial voice

mr_passthrough.hook: VR meets your real room — a virtual object on your real table. Which Quest 3 feature?
mr_passthrough.recall: What do passthrough + Scene API + anchors give you?
mr_passthrough.answer: mixed reality — see your real room and pin virtual objects to it (spatial anchors)

vr_performance.hook: Drop below 72fps in VR and users feel sick. How do you hold the frame?
vr_performance.recall: How do you keep VR at 72fps?
vr_performance.answer: profiler + draw-call batching + ASTC textures + fewer/optimized draw calls

ship_to_store.hook: It works in your headset — now get it on the Meta Store. The path?
ship_to_store.recall: Steps to ship a Quest app?
ship_to_store.answer: dev account, keystore-signed release APK, store listing + privacy/age rating, submit for review
